quotes.text: Had such an amazing experience for our dad's birthday! They can add on decorations and it looked amazing. So relaxing, easy to drive if it's your first time. Overall amazing experience and would absolutely love to do it again! Great crew!

We had a great time with our boat rental. It was very relaxing. We brought a picnic and enjoyed the time on the water. We have 3 teenage/young adult boys and they enjoyed it too. Staff was friendly and the whole process went smoothly.

Wonderful experience. We got a double kayak and went out on the water in Huntington Harbor and it was so much fun! It's definitely a workout but so worth it to see all the beautiful homes, amazing boats, and sea life swimming nearby.

My team had a great time. We rented TWO Duffy boats which were clean and ready to go when we arrived. The dock crew was super nice and made sure our captains were well informed and comfortable. We will definitely be doing this again!

13 of us fit on the boat. Staff was patient. The kids had a great time. We did two hours but it seemed like it went by so fast. We were able to bring our food on the boat. It was my son's 10th birthday, kids and adults enjoyed it!

Thank you to Zully! She went above and beyond to make this experience as fun and safe as possible. We were a group of 10 with 2 kids under 7 and they loved it. The people along the route wave hello and the kids loved that...
